_doc: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for app identity. Edit fields, then run `make rebrand` (scripts/branding-update.sh) to propagate to configs, Cargo.toml, package.json, NSIS hooks and scripts. Xcode and Android Studio keep their OWN app icons/schemes — not managed here by design.
_notManaged: mobile (iOS/Android) icons and Xcode schemes: managed in src-tauri/vendor template + Assets, NOT here. icons.master feeds the mobile icon regeneration (apple-xcode.sh / android-autogen.sh run `tauri icon` post-init); the vendored templates ship neutral placeholders.
name: Tauri-react-template
description: Tauri + React + Vite template — generic multi-platform (iOS/Android/desktop) with Xcode layers
